atoms.claimText: Other clearances or instructions, including conditional clearances, shall be read back or acknowledged in a manner that clearly indicates that they have been understood and will be complied with.
requiredBehaviour: read back or acknowledge other clearances or instructions in a way that clearly indicates understanding and compliance
applicability: other clearances or instructions transmitted by voice, including conditional clearances
